mo_ta_cong_viec:
Teko Solution combines a modern engineering environment with a team of seasoned experts. We research and build technology products and solutions across Retail/E-commerce, Enterprise Solutions and Carbon Technology.
 
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Design, build and operate complex systems and services that are highly performant, reliable and scalable.
Own the product end to end — continuously profile and optimize code and full-stack performance (web rendering, components, UI/UX, API latency, database queries, caching, Core Web Vitals), and monitor, triage and resolve production incidents by digging into the hard technical problems underneath.
Architect solutions and tackle complex technical problems. 
Make effective use of AI tooling (Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to optimize productivity; review and verify the quality of AI-generated code and designs. Build shared AI agents, custom skills, templates and standards for your stack or for use across teams.
Lead and mentor team members, review code and help grow their technical expertise.
yeu_cau:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Applied Mathematics or a related field.
Problem Solving:
- Strong fundamentals in Data Structures & Algorithms, with the logical reasoning to break down high-complexity technical problems that span multiple parts of the system.
- System Design: Able to architect solutions from module/service level up to product/platform level.
- AI Fluency: Hands-on with AI tooling, able to judge whether AI-generated code and architecture are sound, and able to apply AI effectively across requirement analysis, design, coding, debugging, testing and deployment.
Proficient in at least one programming language and its surrounding framework ecosystem, with a solid grasp of the principles underneath; able to pick up and master new technologies or frameworks quickly as the project requires.
Proactive, fast-thinking and adaptable, with clear communication skills and a strong sense of ownership.
